reason: The hole is real. R25-A1 (4) (CONTEXT l.3742) codes 'L_hi > 10.2 h' as '?'. The only gap exception, PC24-08 (l.3587), covers the non-CI 8.0 h case. The 12:25Z night rule sends everything except '+'/'0u' to exp89q. 10.2 h after 12:14:57Z is 22:27Z, inside 51's expected 21:30-22:15Z window. The ledger shows 3 poll gaps over 15 min (05:06-06:22Z, 14:54-15:15Z, 15:15-15:41Z). PC27-01 traces the last two to battery/lid Modern Standby, and the laptop is still on battery, so a gap tonight is plausible. The logic holds for displays that clear REF: a skipped insertion only lowers the score, so a display >= REF still shows CI helped. The proposed ACTION is too broad, though. (a) It codes EVERY read 'on its display', so under a gap a '-' or '0' becomes a CI-negative verdict where the rule now gives '?'. That verdict has real effects: a C51 '-' puts a CI-risk flag on every CI file on the card, and the exp75 partner rule v2 (a) says 'probe 51 - -> A first'. A skipped insertion alone could explain a 0.957. (b) The 'normal read' is anti-conservative in the MORNING TABLE v1.1. There exp87a's display is the subtrahend in dd = (exp89r - exp89p) - (exp87a - exp85a) and the comparator for Rr. If a skipped insertion lowered exp87a's display, that inflates DIS '+' (-> exp89s) and Rr '+' (-> exp89q). (c) It misses the ordinary 10-min granularity case: L_lo <= 10.2 < L_hi <= ~10.37 h with no gap over 15 min. Expected gain is near zero: about 1% chance of flipping exp89q to exp89r, worth a public-only CI read on one embryo. But it costs nothing (text only, pre-score, no GPU, no build), so it should be logged in a narrowed form.
fix: Log PRE-SCORE now (quote the last poll header with 56640366 PENDING) as GAP RULE v2 (CI), scoped to the night choice. (1) If probe 51 is COMPLETE without error, its display is >= 0.959 or 0.958 with an attributable UP, and L_hi > 10.2 h (whether from a poll gap or the normal 10-min cadence, up to the 10.75 h admit), code '+'/'0u' with the flag UNPROVEN-ins. It counts as a normal read for the 12:25Z exp89r/exp89q choice and for BEST_CI. Add the 'ins-tail?' footnote if L_lo > 9.6 h. (2) If the display is <= 0.958 with no attributable UP (would-be '0' or '-') and L_hi > 10.2 h, it stays '?' as now: no C51 '-', no CI-risk flag, and exp75 partner rule v2 (a) treats 51 as not '-'. (3) MORNING TABLE v1.1: while 51 is UNPROVEN-ins, its display may not be a comparator. Branch-A dd and Rr code '?' unless they also read '+' against exp85a's display (0.958) in place of exp87a's. (4) Before using the rule, tighten L_hi from the e10_watch hourly LB snapshots (the first snapshot where our count goes 52 -> 53). Use the same snapshots for S0/S1 if downloads are missed. (5) Apply the same '+'/'0u'-only asymmetry to exp89r, exp75 (the >= 0.955 pair-B row only) and exp89l. Pair it with PC27-01 (AC power, lid): stopping the gap in the first place is the real protection.
realistic_gain: About 0. Roughly 1% chance (P(51 '+'/'0u') ~0.35 x P(a gap straddling ~22:27Z with completion before it) ~0.03) that the night stack flips from exp89q to exp89r, worth a single-embryo public CI read (<= ~0.0005 private, sign unproven). Cost is zero (text rule, pre-score).
